$description: Semantic interaction-state colors for links. Text remains AA in every theme; icon/edge affordances remain ≥3:1. Hover and visited use distinct, theme-resolved roles; focus uses the canonical focus ring; disabled links remain readable rather than relying on opacity.

hover.$description: Hovered link foreground; underline remains the non-color cue.

focus.$description: Focused link text; pair with focusRing.

disabled.$description: Disabled link text, still readable and distinguished semantically by disabled state.

edge.$description: Link-associated non-text edge; must remain visible against surfaces.
